Linger Homes connects hosts and guests directly. We complement major booking platforms and help owners manage the wider business around them.

Hosts should use appropriate short-term-rental insurance, confirm booking and cancellation terms in writing, use secure traceable payment methods, and follow local registration, tax, and guest-reporting rules. Verify the lead guest's identity only where lawful and necessary, and handle personal information securely.
Requirements differ by country and property. Hosts remain responsible for their agreements, payments, insurance, and legal compliance.
A free direct-booking platform, backed by optional services
We do not charge hosts to list or guests to book through Linger Homes. Our business earns from optional setup, management, channel, and pricing services chosen by property owners.
